PetListing.title: PetListing
PetListing.description: Represents a pet listing for adoption, sale, or services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PetListing entity.

species.description: The species of the pet (e.g., dog, cat, bird).

breed.description: The breed of the pet (e.g., Labrador, Siamese).

description.description: A detailed description of the pet and its characteristics.

age.description: The age of the pet in months or years.

location.description: The location where the pet is available (e.g., city, state).

listingType.description: The type of listing (e.g., adoption, sale, service).

price.description: The price of the pet, if applicable.

isFeatured.description: Indicates if the listing is featured or 'Yıldızlı'.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user profile within the Patisemti application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The email address of the user.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the user.

avatarUrl.description: URL of the user's profile picture.

favoritePetIds.description: References to PetListings that the user has marked as favorites. (Relationship: UserProfile N:N PetListing)

companyType.description: Type of the company for corporate users.

taxNo.description: Tax identification number of the company.

taxOffice.description: The tax office where the company is registered.

companyAddress.description: The registered address of the company.

tcNo.description: Turkish Republic Identity Number for individual corporate owners.

userStatus.description: The status of the user account.

Service.title: Service
Service.description: Represents a pet-related service listed in the directory.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Service entity.

name.description: The name of the service provider.

type.description: The type of service offered (e.g., veterinarian, pet hotel, trainer).

description.description: A detailed description of the services offered.

address.description: The address of the service provider.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the service provider.

websiteUrl.description: The website URL of the service provider.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure is designed to ensure authorization independence, clarity, and scalability for the Patisemti application. It leverages denormalization and structural segregation to avoid complex security rules and enable efficient data retrieval. User profiles and their associated data (pet listings, services) are organized under user-specific paths to enforce clear ownership. Favoriting functionality is implemented using arrays within the user profile.  The structure avoids 'get()' calls in security rules for authorization, enabling atomic operations. Segregation of data with differing access needs is achieved by storing user-specific data under `/users/{userId}` and potentially public data (if any in the future) in separate collections.
